entries.en: You're not going to that whore of yours out in the Badlands! No way!
entries.ro: Nu te duci la cloanța aia de-a ta din Badlands! Nici vorbă!

entries.en: Hon, you don't even know her. Never saw her. How d'you know she's a whore?
entries.ro: Iubito, nici n-o cunoști. N-ai văzut-o în viața ta. De unde știi că-i curvă?

entries.en: Those sandeating sluts are all the same.
entries.ro: Curvele alea de nisip sunt toate la fel.

entries.en: Aaah, you mean Jolie... But she worked in a bakery. Jill's a ripper. Nothing to do with each other.
entries.ro: Aaa, la Jolie te referi... Dar lucra la o brutărie. Jill e ripper. N-au nicio treabă una cu alta.

entries.en: Look, she'll adjust my joints, half-price.
entries.ro: Uite, îmi ajustează articulațiile la jumătate de preț.

entries.en: Fine, go! Just make sure you take all your shit with you, 'cause you won't be coming back here! What do you even see in her?
entries.ro: Bine, du-te! Ia-ți boarfele, că nu mai calci pe aici! Ce dracu' vezi tu la ea?

entries.en: Ehhh, nothing. She's not even pretty... sure got less of a mouth on her, though.
entries.ro: Ehhh, nimic. Nici nu e frumoasă... da' sigur are mai puțin gură.
